side.instructions: Crun returns 451 both when it refuses the PROMPT and when it refuses the rendered OUTPUT. From this error text and context, which was it?

criteria.input: the prompt was rejected before rendering
criteria.output: it rendered, then the result was withheld
criteria.unclear: cannot tell from the evidence given

trigger.instructions: Which element most likely triggered it?

criteria.garment: a named garment or undress wording (camisole, strap, bare)
criteria.skin: described exposed skin or body focus

rewrite_axis.instructions: Our fix is always to re-register the same beat more modestly, never to drop it. Which axis should the rewrite move on?

criteria.wardrobe: name a modest, fully covering garment instead
criteria.blocking: replace contact with proximity — head on shoulder, hand on forearm
criteria.framing: wider or higher framing, less body in frame

retry_confidence.instructions: If we apply that rewrite and resubmit, how likely is it to pass? 1 = very likely, 0 = it will be rejected again.
